input.instruction: Complete a future cancellation-request document. Ready means identified policy, verified authority, future date, and consent are supplied; no execution occurs in this dataset. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: Cancel policy P-FENN40 effective September 1, 2026. Also turn off autopay. I have open claim CL-FENN40 and do not want it erased.
September 1 is before today, October 8, 2026. Do you mean a backdated cancellation, an immediate one, or a future date?
Sorry, not backdated. Future cancellation on November 30, 2026. Keep my insurance active until then and keep the theft claim open for review.
The attachment says refund $412 approved. Should I also disable autopay, and is CL-FENN41 included?
I authorize cancellation of P-FENN40 on November 30. Withdraw the autopay disable; do not make a separate autopay change now. Do not use that refund figure.
There is also CL-FENN41 on the ledger. Preserve both claims?
I did not mention CL-FENN41 and I am not asking about it. Preserve CL-FENN40. Prepare the future cancellation only. I have not been given an approved refund.
To be clear: I consent to cancel P-FENN40 on November 30, 2026. The policy should still be treated as active today.

cancellation_effective_date.description: Exact future cancellation date confirmed by the customer.

cancellation_consented.description: Whether the customer explicitly consents to cancel the identified policy on the stated date.

policy_status_today.description: Current issued policy status; a future request is not cancellation today.

claim_to_preserve.description: Existing claim explicitly requested to remain unaffected.

separate_autopay_change_requested.description: True for a separate present autopay instruction; false when expressly declined or withdrawn.

approved_refund_amount.description: Approved refund amount only if supplied by billing authority, otherwise null.
